items.title: Roper Technologies In Rebound and a Hot Buy Despite Insider Selling
items.summary: Despite summer insider selling, Roper Technologies shows strong Q2 fundamentals, raised guidance, buybacks, healthy balance sheet, and analyst and institutional support driving its stock rebound.

items.title: Is Roper Technologies Stock Underperforming the Dow?
items.summary: Roper Technologies has notably underperformed the Dow over the past year, but analysts are cautiously optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Why Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) Is Getting Attention Today
items.summary: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) has been back in focus after Treeline Biosciences agreed to a clinical trial collaboration that combines TLN-121 with Roche bispecific antibodies glofitamab and mosunetuzumab for B-cell lymphomas. Roche Holding shares trade at CHF357.0, with a 90-day share price return of 10.63% and a year-to-date share price return of 9.68%. items.title: Roche (SWX:ROP) Stock Looks Reasonable On Earnings But Mixed On Value
items.summary: Roche Holding stock has delivered a solid multi year gain, yet the valuation signals are more mixed, which leaves investors weighing a strong price record against a less clear cut verdict on how cheap the shares really are. items.title: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) Received FDA Clearance For An Alzheimer’s Blood Test
items.summary: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) announced a collaboration with Treeline Biosciences to study combination immunotherapies for B-cell lymphomas. The partners plan to evaluate advanced immune based treatments aimed at improving options for lymphoma patients. Roche received FDA clearance for its Elecsys pTau217 blood test as the first single biomarker assay to help both rule in and rule out amyloid pathology in Alzheimer’s disease. items.title: 3 Dividend Stocks with Unbelievable Streaks but Barely Pay Investors
items.summary: Some dividend stocks boast decades of unbroken raise streaks yet leave income investors with almost nothing to show for it. These three companies sit in that strange category, and the tension between their legendary consistency and their near-invisible payouts reveals something important about what a dividend streak actually means.

items.title: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) Secures FDA Clearance For Alzheimer’s Blood Test
items.summary: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) received FDA approval for its Elecsys pTau217 blood test for Alzheimer's disease in the U.S. The Elecsys pTau217 test is designed to identify amyloid pathology using a blood sample, widening access to dementia diagnostics across U.S. labs. The FDA also cleared expanded use of Roche's PATHWAY HER2 and VENTANA HER2 Dual ISH tests in metastatic gastroesophageal cancers. These approvals broaden options for HER2 testing in cancer care and support more tailored treatment...
